findings.detail: 'new' is allocated via the non-zeroing PyObject_New() and freed on an error path (Py_DECREF/Py_XDECREF/Py_CLEAR) before its members are NULL-initialized — tp_dealloc/tp_clear then reads uninitialized member pointers (crash, esp. under OOM). Zero the object right after allocation (memset or `new->member = NULL;` before the first fallible call).
